Shared table for whitespace-keeping tag removal, read by go/strings_test.go (StripHTMLTags) and test/string.test.ts (stripHtmlTags) so neither language can drift. Each <...> span is removed and nothing is inserted in its place, which leaves an element's text content, except that a
(ASCII letters, optional namespace prefix) with no line break on either side of it in the source, across spaces or tabs, becomes a line break; every other character, whitespace included, passes through. This is the prose-carrying counterpart of StripHTML/stripHtml, which collapses whitespace runs and trims.
